mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-f59f9bef.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep=next((i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in r)),None)
    if sep is None: return g
    top=next((r for r in g[:sep] if any(v not in (0,2) for v in r)),None)
    bot=next((r for r in g[sep+1:] if any(v not in (0,2) for v in r)),None)
    if top is None or bot is None:return g
    c=next(v for v in top if v)
    # Connect matching colored markers from the top/bottom, filling vertical gaps in columns
    for x in range(w):
        if top[x]==c and bot[x]==c:
            for y in range(1,sep):
                if g[y][x]==0:g[y][x]=4
    return g
PY
